title: The Music Stand That Would Not Tighten
youtube_title: The Music Stand That Would Not Tighten | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Kindness leaves a person with their dignity intact.
summary: At a school hallway of pegs, stools, and music stands, a music stand that would not tighten is awkward for one person. Paz notices Neighbor Sami struggling and takes a useful half of the job without asking to be praised.
